content.short: Shrapnel is a high-end decentralized extraction shooter featuring deep narrative and digital ownership.
content.description: Shrapnel is a groundbreaking Web3 extraction shooter that combines a deep narrative-driven experience with the power of digital asset ownership. Set in a dystopian world, players engage in high-stakes combat and resource management, where every achievement and item can be owned and traded as a unique digital asset (NFT). The game features a sophisticated player-driven economy and a persistent online world that evolves based on community actions. By utilizing high-performance blockchain infrastructure, Shrapnel offers a seamless and immersive AAA gaming experience that redefines the boundaries of decentralized entertainment and player-centric digital economies, fostering a vibrant global community of gamers.
content.meta: Shrapnel is a premier decentralized extraction shooter, offering deep narrative-driven gameplay and digital asset ownership for global gamers.
